policy.identity: Name differences (macrons, spelling and transliteration, nicknames, middle or title tokens, name order) are resolved on evidence and judgement with a recorded confidence and reasoning; absence of an exact string match is never treated as a different person. Names that differ and have no evidence of being the same person are treated as different people only where the incumbent is documented as leaving the seat.
policy.noEffect: No replacement effect, residual or coefficient is estimated or used in this pass.
policy.unknownIsNotZero: An undocumented departure reason is recorded as unknown, never as retirement by default.

transitionTypes.boundary_complication: Seat abolished or reshaped so the incumbent recontested elsewhere while the dominant successor seat received a different candidate.
transitionTypes.by_election_party_change: Mid-term vacancy lost to another party at a by-election; the N/L candidate faces a different-party incumbent. Not an incumbent-to-successor transition.
transitionTypes.by_election_succession: Mid-term vacancy filled by a same-party by-election; the by-election winner is the effective incumbent who recontested, so the target candidate is not a newcomer at the election.
transitionTypes.death_or_illness_withdrawal: Candidate withdrew for illness or died before the election and was replaced.
transitionTypes.deselection: Sitting MP lost a party selection contest for the seat.
transitionTypes.party_change: Outgoing incumbent left or was expelled from the party; may or may not have recontested under another label.
transitionTypes.resignation_before_election: Seat vacated before the target election with no by-election; successor is a new candidate for an open seat.
transitionTypes.retirement: Sitting electorate MP did not contest the seat at the target election by choice, including list-only moves and withdrawals without a documented selection loss; tags carry scandal, list-only and dismissal context.
